fx.direction: 1 unit of source_currency = rate units of target_currency
fx.fallback: Rates are published Monday-Friday only; use the latest published date on or before the rate date.
fx.rate_date: Invoice bookings use the rate for the local date of issued_at; payment bookings use the rate for the local date of the payment timestamp (company timezone).

ledger_currency: All ledger rows are in the functional currency (minor units).

payments.application: A receipt is applied (Cr 1100 with invoice_id and payment_id) to every invoice listed in invoice_refs for the referenced amount. Only the part of a receipt not covered by invoice_refs (or the whole receipt when invoice_refs is null) goes to 2200.
payments.carrying_amount: AR relieved = referenced amount converted at the invoice's booking rate; a reference that settles the invoice in full relieves its booked AR amount.
payments.fx_difference: Bank debit minus credits is posted to 7900.
payments.refunds: kind=refund returns previously unapplied cash: Dr 2200 / Cr 1000.

period.membership: A timestamp belongs to the period if its local calendar date in the company timezone is within [start, end] inclusive. Printed offsets on documents vary.

revenue_recognition: An invoice is recognised (Dr 1100 / Cr 4000, payment_id null) in the period that contains its issued_at; booking may lag issuance but never crosses a period.
